newsitem.title: UK: National Power, PowerGen slip again.
newsitem.headline: National Power, PowerGen slip again.

text.p: Power generators National Power Plc and PowerGen Plc were among the biggest fallers in the FTSE 100 index on Wednesday, continuing a decline sparked by Tuesday's cautious comments from National Power, dealers said.

National Power chairman John Baker told shareholders competition in the home market was expected to intensify through the next one or two years. National Power shares, which fell 12p on Tuesday, slipped another 11-1/2p to 559-1/2 by 1102 GMT.
PowerGen was down 18p to 751-1/2 after a 9p decline the previous session.
Analysts at Williams de Broe cut National Power to a "hold" and dealers at other houses said they were cautious on the two stocks.
"There is a bit of worry about growing domestic competition," said one.
Elsewhere in the sector, Southern Electric Plc was down 14-1/2p to 435 and Scottish Hydro Plc eased 8p to 444-1/2.
